items.summary: CRO handoff: preserve existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next revenue experiment after capacity and site-overlap clearance. Test current merchandising CTA treatment against a clearer primary CTA with adjacent affiliate disclosure, unchanged destinations, and accessible focus states. Evidence: 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; Amazon's $4.92 aggregate commission remains unattributed. Metric: affiliate-click rate and attributable ordered items over 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks. Do not claim revenue or causal lift before measurement.

CRO product opportunity: commission a disposable, rights-safe content-discovery prototype using microsoft/markitdown for sites with existing SEO demand. The repository is MIT-licensed, the CRO lab recorded 22 relevant keyword hits and 8/8 bounded checks passed, but no dependencies were installed and no adoption conclusion is supported. Prototype only: convert up to five owner-approved local documents into Markdown, generate a diff and metadata-quality report, and measure reviewer acceptance time and usable-draft rate; do not publish, add tracking, or process third-party content. Risks include parser omissions, unsafe or stale dependencies, source-rights ambiguity, maintenance burden, and low editorial usefulness. Estimated time-to-learn: 2–3 engineering days after capacity clears. Keep as a CTO-reviewed research lead, not a production admission.
